title: A review-record comment that does not parse is flagged when it is posted and when the runner reads it
why: Lane notes-fix-guard-1 (session_013NEJL3G6vFtN2TjNZrMETW, 08:37 CST Nov 8) posted four review records with free text after the CI line (#1926, #1531, #2016, #1989). parse_review (merge/merge.py:3193) returned None, so the batch runner would see no record. Nothing warned until a --fix-check refusal on #1989; each was fixed by hand.
note: Guard idea: when a PR comment opens with the review-record marker but parse_review returns None, flag it, in `merge --review-record` and in the runner's record read. The remedy text names the form that parses: free text goes below a `---` line after the CI line (lane notes-fix-large-3, 08:38 CST Nov 8). Not folded into review-record-post-parses: that step is built as #1706, past round 3. Done check: a red test where a marker comment with text right after the CI line is flagged, naming the `---` remedy. Build lane. Filed by triage 08:38 CST Nov 8. Started by the coordinator 08:40 CST Nov 8 in lane session_013NEJL2g4J2bZLchTFF8RGp, built on #1706. Folded in, lane lint-before-record-push 13:10 CST Nov 8 (proposed step record-post-shape-check): a review-record comment with prose between the CI line and the `---` footer is malformed to `parse_review`, and the poster learns it only when `--fix-check` or the runner fails. Incident: #1755 and #2032, three comments rewritten in place. Fix: check the body with `parse_review` before posting a comment that starts with the review-record marker. Related: review-record-post-check. Coordinator 13:12 CST Nov 8: the cause fix is step record-tool-posts-itself (802); this step stays the read-side check. Sighting (lane revive-1042, session_013NEJL2GCahFnLKLzmw1JAM, 15:09 CST Nov 8): `merge --review-record` prints the record without its `---` attribution footer. The lane added a finding paragraph between the CI line and the footer, parse_review returned None, and a later --fix-check was refused. Proposed fix: print the record with the footer, so no gap is left to add text into. Coordinator 16:21 CST Nov 8 (asked for step record-post-parse-flag, folded here): two more incidents. #2294's lane posted two record comments with the marker line cut off, and #2317's lane posted one with a note before `---`. The merge tool read none of the three as a record, and nothing said so. Scope to add: `merge --reviewed` (merge/merge.py reviewed_lines and parse_review) flags each PR comment that looks like a record but does not parse. That covers a marker with no parse, and field lines with no marker. The flag names the comment id and the first failing line. Flag only, no refusal. Cost: no extra reads, since --reviewed already reads the comments.
